description: Check the MCP servers configured on this computer (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf) for risks such as broad filesystem access, unpinned packages, remote servers without auth, auto-approved tools and API keys stored in plain text. Only the server definitions are read, and secret values are masked on this computer before anything is sent.

path.description: Optional: a specific MCP config file. Leave empty to check all known locations.

name: scan_mcp_config
title: Check my MCP servers
